meta.titleDefault: Boston Milal Korean Church | Chelmsford, MA
meta.description: Boston Milal Korean Church is a Korean Presbyterian (KAPC) church in Chelmsford, MA, in Greater Boston. Sunday worship is at 10:00 AM at 15 Alpha Road.

home.title: Home
home.metaDescription: Boston Milal is a Korean Presbyterian (KAPC) church in Chelmsford. Sunday worship is at 10:00 AM at 15 Alpha Road. The service is in Korean, in Greater Boston.
home.motto: Serve one another as good stewards (1 Peter 4:10)
home.intro: We are a Korean Presbyterian church in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, in Greater Boston.
home.intro2: Sunday worship is at 10:00 AM at 15 Alpha Road. The service is in Korean.
home.intro3: Children's and youth worship meet on Sunday. There is also a Korean School.
home.photoAlt: Musicians leading worship in the sanctuary

worship.title: Worship and gatherings
worship.metaDescription: Sunday worship at Boston Milal is at 10:00 AM at 15 Alpha Road in Chelmsford. The service is in Korean. Find the weekly order of worship and meeting times.
worship.intro: Join us for Sunday worship at 10:00 AM. You can also find this week's order of worship and our other gatherings here.
worship.onlineBody: You can also watch on YouTube.
worship.photoAlt: String ensemble playing during worship in the main sanctuary

visit.title: Visit
visit.metaDescription: Plan your first visit to Boston Milal Korean Church. Sunday worship is at 10:00 AM at 15 Alpha Road in Chelmsford, Massachusetts.
visit.intro: We would be glad to welcome you. Here are the details you need for a first Sunday with us.
visit.entranceBody: Come in through the main door.
visit.expectBody: Sunday worship is at 10:00 AM in the main sanctuary.
visit.parkingBody: Park in the church parking lot at 15 Alpha Road.
visit.kidsBody: Children's worship meets during the Sunday service. Times and rooms are on the Generations page.
visit.kidsPhotoAlt: Children and teachers at a classroom table
visit.contactBody: Ask someone after worship, or send a message on Facebook.

about.title: About
about.metaDescription: Boston Milal Korean Church is a Korean Presbyterian (KAPC) church in Chelmsford, Massachusetts, in Greater Boston. We belong to the New England Presbytery.
about.intro: Boston Milal is a Korean Presbyterian congregation in Chelmsford, Massachusetts. Our name, Milal, means a grain of wheat.
about.motto: Serve one another as good stewards (1 Peter 4:10)
about.pastorBio: He studied theology at Chongshin University, then M.Div. and Th.M. at Gordon-Conwell. He previously served as pastor of Lebanon Korean Presbyterian Church.
about.identity: We are a Korean Presbyterian congregation serving Greater Boston. We gather in Chelmsford and worship in Korean.
about.congregationAlt: Church members gathered outdoors in front of the building

generations.title: Generations
generations.metaDescription: Children's and youth worship at Boston Milal, a Korean church in Chelmsford. Toddlers, elementary, youth, and young adults. Times and rooms are on this page.
generations.intro: Children, youth, and young adults have a place to worship and grow in faith at Boston Milal.
generations.childrenAlt: Children's class around a table with teachers
generations.youthAlt: Youth and leaders around a table with a guitar

koreanSchool.title: Korean School
koreanSchool.metaDescription: Boston Milal Korean School offers Sunday classes in Korean language and culture for children in Chelmsford, Massachusetts.
koreanSchool.intro: Our Sunday school helps children learn Korean language and culture together.
koreanSchool.goals: Children learn to read and speak Korean while discovering Korean culture in a church community.
koreanSchool.time: Sundays, 9:30-10:30 AM, in the spring and fall.
koreanSchool.photoAlt: Korean School children and teachers walking together on a field trip
